usedFor: SerwerSMS holds sent and received text messages, and Google Drive handles files with “Copy a File” and “Share File”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Received” in SerwerSMS, then “Share File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A reply can call for a document, so the action grants access to a chosen person.

watchOut: “New Message Received” in SerwerSMS is polling, so files are shared after a scheduled check.
